name: Thanksgiving
_comment: Every url must extract as kind=recipe with an image (curl /api/recipe/extract?url=...&refresh=1). Optional yields/total_time_s override the extracted values (null hides them). Outranks the Christmas deck (priority 10) for its whole window, so November is Thanksgiving and Christmas takes over on Nov 29; move 'start' later to give early November back to Christmas.

ui.hint: Tap to wake — then ＋ to add it to My Recipes
